# Evidence-Gated Pathology Model

## Introduction

We tested our model on N=500 prostate cancer WSIs.
The baseline accuracy was 82.1%.

## Results

Our method achieved an AUROC=0.87 on the test set.
However, we also claim a 99.9% accuracy on a proprietary dataset
that has no supporting ledger entry.

## Discussion

This represents a significant improvement over prior work.
